summary: Tiered turret bases enforce their legacy inventory, upgrade stacking, resource formulas and adjacent turret limits on the logical server.

authoritative_state: TurretBaseBlockEntity owns the stable 13-slot inventory and decides which slots are enabled by its tier.
Upgrade levels are derived from server-owned ItemStack counts in enabled upgrade slots.
TurretHeadBlockEntity uses server-derived shared dynamic range, accuracy, scatter, energy and fire interval values.
Turret attachment legality is computed from the six blocks adjacent to the owning base.

fields: inventory:CompoundTag remains a stable 13-slot ItemStackHandler payload
slot enablement is derived from the registered BaseTier and is not duplicated in NBT
upgrade levels are derived from ItemStack counts and are not cached in NBT

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: Inventory rules, upgrade formulas, resource consumption and attachment limits require no client classes.

generated: Updated en_us and zh_cn creative-tab display names.

budgets.scope: One turret survival or placement validation
budgets.measurement: Count the six Direction values visited by the adjacency scan.

performance.measurement_environment: Java 21, NeoForge GameTest server and a six-neighbor base fixture.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

criteria.statement: Upgrade levels sum ItemStack counts only from enabled slots and disabled legacy contents remain persisted and recoverable when the base is removed.
criteria.observation: The migration acceptance command exits 0 after demonstrating this condition: Upgrade levels sum ItemStack counts only from enabled slots and disabled legacy contents remain persisted and recoverable when the base is removed.

steps: Open each of the five base tiers in survival.
Shift-click ammunition, addons and every upgrade type in and out.
Inspect disabled-slot behavior after loading a deliberately old inventory payload.
manual_checks.expected: Only enabled slots are interactive, shift-click chooses a semantically valid slot, and no stored item is lost.

steps: Install scatter upgrades in a tier-five base.
Fire projectile and beam turret families with exactly enough and one-less-than-enough resources.
manual_checks.expected: Each legal volley creates the expected number of shots and consumes matching resources; an underfunded volley does not partially consume.

non_goals: Solar, redstone reactor, recycler, concealment, fake-drop or loot-deleter behavior.
Target priority editing, multi-target selection, warnings or team policy expansion.
Final legacy GUI textures, BER models or addon visual geometry.
Changing the openmodularturrets mod id, Java package or registry ids.
